name: Ricotta & Spinach Stuffed Zucchini "Cannelloni" with Tomato Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach
6 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Coarsely grate mozzarella. Finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (227 g) blocks mozzarella cheese
170 g Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the water in the pot comes to a boil, remove lid, add the spinach and stir for a few seconds. Cook the spinach, uncovered, until wilted, 30-60 seconds. Once done, drain the spinach in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then transfer to a cutting board. Roughly chop spinach and transfer a large bowl.
Add basil, ricotta, eggs, salt, pepper, Parmesan, and half of the mozzarella to the bowl with the spinach. Stir until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese
3 eggs
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or press garlic.
Divide tomato sauce between two baking dishes. Add garlic, tomato paste, and Italian seasoning (dividing evenly between baking dishes) and stir until combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
3 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Trim ends from zucchini; use a knife or vegetable peeler to slice zucchini lengthwise into very thin slices.

Place a heaping tablespoon of the ricotta mixture at one end of each zucchini slice. Roll up the slices and place in the baking dishes with the tomato sauce, leaving at least a ½-inch space between rolls.
Sprinkle remaining mozzarella over top of the cannelloni.
Place in the oven and bake until cooked through, 18-20 minutes.
To serve, divide cannelloni and sauce between plates and enjoy!
